messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — opened PR #8123 to change default retry/backoff behavior in the go-client and a small tweak to toolcall streaming headers to preserve binary metadata. Can someone take a quick look? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-client/pull/8123

CI Bot: build failed on macos-latest unit tests (flaky) — see logs: https://ci.redwood/s/8123/logs

Samir Patel: taking a look now. What's the intended semantic for the backoff change? multiplier 1.5 -> 2 and any perf concerns?

Maya Chen: yep, multiplier -> 2 and add a jitter floor. Goal is to reduce thundering-herd retries on transient 503s from model variants. Expect slightly higher tail latency for retrying clients but fewer repeated downstream failures. Added backoff_test.go and a short benchmark.

Li Zhao: CI shows failing TestToolcallHeaderPreserve. Local stack:
```
=== RUN   TestToolcallHeaderPreserve
panic: concurrent map write
/…/kvcache_test.go:87 +0x45
```

Joel Rivera: looks like the header patch is assigning a map directly. We should use CopyHeaderValues() helper to avoid shared map mutation — fixed this recently in streaming-v2.

Li Zhao: ok will try that locally and push a fix.

CI Bot: note: linux/amd64 matrix passed, macos-race flagged concurrent map write in kvcache_test.go. Re-run scheduled after push.

Samir Patel: mapping to INF-427 for rollout notes. Also flagging that this default change could affect Dedicated customers if they pin old SDK behavior; @Joel can you eyeball the PreserveBinaryHeaders flag and ensure compatibility across runtimes?

Joel Rivera: @Maya quick nit — please add an entry under Unreleased in the changelog for go-client with migration notes and a one-line comment in backoff.go about why multiplier=2 (reduce retries causing downstream overload).

Diana K: when do you plan to merge? Any rolling update considerations for Dedicated customers / Reserved capacity?

Maya Chen: prefer to merge after green CI across all matrices. For Dedicated: no runtime config change required; only SDK default changed for new versions. Plan to canary in us-west-2 and watch error budgets before global rollout. Migration note included.

Li Zhao: pushed header-copy fix (used CopyHeaderValues()). Triggering CI.

CI Bot: re-run complete — all checks passed: go-client unit/integration, e2e streaming smoke. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/s/8123/artifacts

Samir Patel: LGTM — left an approving review :thumbsup:

Joel Rivera: Approved after changelog nit fixed.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone! Will merge in ~30m during the merge window. :rocket:

Maya Chen: merged and released v0.9.6 — changelog: small backoff/jitter update + header-preserve for toolcall streaming. @all please watch for regressions; will roll back if errors > 0.5% over 15m :eyes:

Operations Bot: Release v0.9.6 deployed to hosted and dedicated staging clusters. Monitor: https://observability.redwood/releases/v0.9.6
